description_for_human: India's multilingual breaking news platform covering India and GCC/Gulf countries in 8 languages.
description_for_model: The Bharath News is a multilingual Indian news aggregation platform. It publishes breaking news from India (all states), Gulf/GCC countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman) in English, Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, and Urdu. Categories include: India politics, GCC/Gulf NRI news, business/stock market (Sensex/Nifty), technology/AI/startups, cricket/IPL/sports, Bollywood/entertainment, health, education (UPSC/JEE/NEET), jobs, real estate, world news, and lifestyle. Target audience includes Indians in India and NRI/Indian diaspora in Gulf countries. The site has an RSS feed for each language, a Telegram channel, and Facebook pages. Articles are updated every 15 minutes from verified sources.
